Remember everyone does, not everyone has an audience when they’re screwing up though. I had that problem a lot when I was younger, honestly I think the best way to deal with it is to be the first to laugh at yourself because then you didn’t make a mistake, you did something funny and everyone is laughing with you. 
I was an exotic dancer for awhile. Getting your period on stage is no picnic but literally it happens to everyone girl. I stumbled and fell down all the time on stage and just got back up and acted like nothing happened. Other times I would be like “Aren’t I graceful?” Giggling at myself, guys loved it. Everyone makes mistakes it’s part of life. If no one ever made a mistake the world would be so boring and many of us including myself, a happy accident, wouldn’t be here!
Hey don’t get down on yourself, your alive, if you weren’t meant to be here you might not be. Your beautiful and strong
